query: Accurate Painting of the Palm Beaches West Palm Beach FL
name: Accurate Painting of the Palm Beaches
address: 5211 Cannon Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33415, United States

reviewSamples.author: James Jordan
reviewSamples.text: Fantastic painter with excellent craftsmanship and a professional attitude. The work was completed on time with a clean, smooth finish and great attention to detail. Very reliable service and easy communication throughout the project.

reviewSamples.author: Mark Sites
reviewSamples.text: Accurate is more than a painting company, it is a family that has proven itself over years that not only can it compete with the larger companies, that more importantly it can consistently produce a better product!! Their professionalism and attention to detail is rarely found. ... I interviewed 5 different companies!!! ... I can tell you with the utmost confidence that if you hire Accurate Painting you will not be disappointed!! Mark Sites, West Palm Beach

reviewSamples.author: KellyBelle VanDell
reviewSamples.text: I have used Accurate Painting twice now to paint the interior of my home. Not only are Sharon and the guys timely and professional, but they exceeded our expectations by being proactive and going beyond what most would consider to "get the job done." They were timely, meticulous in their painting and patch work, and very courteous! I can't recommend them highly enough and I plan to use them again when the need arises! Do not hesitate to use Accurate Painting, you won't be disappointed!

reviewSamples.author: Tanya Te
reviewSamples.text: The team at accurate painting was very professional and courteous. The painters arrived on time and the quality of the work was exceptional. They painted my entire down stairs with two accent walls as well as upstairs. I also had an issue with the closet door in my guest bathroom and they were able to fix that for us. I would definitely use them again. They were phenomenal and the work was very neat. The owner Sharon also stopped by to say thank you and hello. Great company.

reviewSamples.author: Valerie H
reviewSamples.text: Our house was painted by Accurate Painting of the Palm Beaches back in July 2014, and we couldn't be more pleased. ... Sharon is a wonderful person, as well as her husband and staff! They helped us figure out paint colors and even did some samples out back for us. They also did some extra carpentry work for us, which turned out great. ... We highly recommend them, and will definitely use them again once we are ready to paint the interior of our house.
